title: Professional Email Product Changes Between Tiers
content:
Rules for moving a Professional Email subscription to another product.

## In force

1. A product change may be made only while the subscription status is active.
2. A move up to one of the product's upgrade targets takes effect at once where the product allows a mid-term move up; a Pro upgrade (the move of an email subscription up to the top product of its family: Harborline Mail Pro from Harborline Mail Starter or Plus, and Microsoft 365 Business Premium from Microsoft 365 Business Basic or Standard) is billed as its own rule states, and every other move up is billed as the price difference per seat for the billing plan times the seats times the months of the plan, times the remaining calendar days of the term over its calendar days, rounded half up to the cent.
3. A move down is only scheduled for the next renewal. At every renewal other than a reactivation renewal or a term renewal, where the product requires mailbox data to fit before a downgrade, each mailbox must already fit the lower product's mailbox storage when the renewal runs; otherwise the change is skipped at that renewal.
4. Moving between Harborline Mail and Microsoft 365 is never a product change but a new subscription with migration, offered free from the product's free-migration seat count and otherwise at its fee per mailbox migrated.

> Former clause, no longer in force: where the product requires mailbox data to fit before a downgrade, each mailbox must already fit the lower product's mailbox storage when the renewal runs, otherwise the change is skipped at that renewal.

> Former clause, no longer in force: a move up to one of the product's upgrade targets takes effect at once where the product allows a mid-term move up and is billed as the price difference per seat for the billing plan times the seats times the months of the plan, times the remaining calendar days of the term over its calendar days, rounded half up to the cent.

## Quantities of a move-up charge

| Quantity | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Price difference | the target product's seat price less the current seat price, for the billing plan |
| Remaining days | calendar days from today to the term end date |
| Term days | calendar days from the term start date to the term end date |
| Months of the plan | 12 on the annual prepaid plan |

## Worked example (hypothetical prices)

A move up of 20 seats on the annual prepaid plan with a hypothetical price difference of 4.00 per seat and 146 remaining days in a 365-day term: 4.00 times 20 times 12 is 960.00, times 146 divided by 365 is 384.00.

superseded_clauses: where retention_on_downgrade is true each mailbox must already fit the lower product's mailbox_storage_gb when the renewal runs, otherwise the change is skipped at that renewal.

A move up to one of the product's upgrade_targets takes effect at once where upgrade_mid_term_allowed is true and is billed as the price difference per seat for the billing plan times the seats times the months of the plan, times the remaining calendar days of the term over its calendar days, rounded half up to the cent.
